lines.3: 「If he catches you sleeping, boys get a fist of discipline and girls run ten laps around the field.」
lines.4: 「How much is this lipstick? Around two thousand yen?」
lines.6: 「Your bare skin is lovely, Kinu, but you should at least use some powder to protect it from the sun.」
lines.7: 「If I'm not careful, the veins around my nose show through, so concealer's a must for me.」
lines.10: 「You oughta pretty yourself up too. Keep going like this and you'll end up in my ending.」
lines.12: 「Fashion, huh? You mean pluck my eyebrows and wear cologne like Fukahire?」
lines.13: I was not really into that kind of thing.
lines.14: Besides, it sounded like a pain.
